# THE UNLOADED PLANE (law7_unloaded_plane_apply.rs): the plane a 1.5.5-shaped config does not use,
# and what the test reads of it. One fact per line:
#   section  <key>     the plane's declaring section, which the refusal names (the manifest's
#                      `linked-section` row that states it is the plane's door row, and that row's
#                      package names the plane)
#   admin    <path>    an admin path (under /api/v1/admin) the plane serves once loaded
# The plane's own section and its door path are the tool plane's fixtures (tool_plane_section.yaml,
# tool_plane_wire.txt); its declaring section's body is unloaded_plane_sections.yaml.
